decision_record.question: What infrastructure executes T11 (the single authorized FULL-scale Causal Forest fit) and the D31 500K seed-robustness/GCP-parity legs without ever materializing held-out rows or the whole 13,979,592-row population, and with crash-safe, resumable, immutable governed evidence?

partition_loader.mechanism: _source_row_id is provably the row's positional ordinal in the processed Parquet file -- verified from src.data._augment_with_source_ids (np.arange(offset, offset+batch.num_rows) per batch) and enforced as a frozen contract by validate_processed_parquet's ordinal-continuity check (source_row_id.complete_unique_ordered). This licenses pyarrow.dataset.Dataset.take(indices, columns=...) directly on requested source_row_id values as row positions -- a compact int64 positional read, not a value-based isin filter and not a Python set()/list() of the requested ids.
partition_loader.rejected_alternative: sorted(set(all_ids)) + a whole-dataset Arrow isin filter -- rejected (T11 CODE PLAN correction, round 2) for duplicating millions of ids at the Python level with no compensating benefit once Dataset.take() was shown feasible.
guarantees: no Python set/list duplication of the requested ids
preserves exact frozen ascending source_row_id order
fails closed (DataContractError) on duplicate, missing, or out-of-range ids -- never silently deduplicates or drops rows
projects only the declared columns (never a superset)
TRAIN and VALIDATION are always loaded via independent calls; the two frames never coexist, and no call ever requests held-out ids
partition_loader.equivalence_evidence: tests/test_data.py: test_materialize_by_source_row_id_matches_legacy_isin_filter_exactly and test_materialize_by_source_row_id_full_population_matches_legacy_full_scan prove byte-for-byte column/row/dtype/order equality against the pre-T11 materialize_pandas + pandas .isin().sort_values() pattern every T07-T10 notebook cell used, on a real synthetic parquet built via convert_csv_to_parquet. Additional tests cover duplicate-id, undeclared-column, missing-SOURCE_ROW_ID, out-of-range, and empty-request rejection. 23/23 tests/test_data.py passed.

checkpointing.design: Append-only, hash-chained checkpoints (audit/checkpoints/001_started.json .. 004_finalized.json), never one mutated checkpoint.json. Each checkpoint records the sha256 of the immediately prior checkpoint file (prior_checkpoint_sha256), so _read_checkpoint_chain() can detect a tampered or partially-written history and refuse to resume from it. Resume re-enters at the highest checkpoint whose chain verifies, and never repeats a completed, hashed step.
checkpointing.atomic_artifact_sequence: Large artifacts (serialized model, persisted predictions) use src.data.write_bytes_new_atomic: write to a .tmp sibling in the same directory -> flush() -> os.fsync() -> os.replace() (atomic on POSIX and Windows) -> sha256 of the now-complete file -> only then is the checkpoint recording that hash written. The destination path never observably exists in a partially-written state.
checkpointing.run_config_immutability: audit/run_config.json is written exactly once, before fit, alongside checkpoint 001, and is never touched again afterward -- verified by tests/test_causal_forest_runner.py::test_full_stage_run_config_written_once_and_never_mutated. All output hashes (model, predictions, diagnostic summary) live only in checkpoints and the final audit/artifact_manifest.json.
checkpointing.resume_identity_enforcement: Resuming a run_root re-validates stage/run_id/population_size/sampling_seed/model_seed/dataset_sha256/config_hash/train_ids_identity/validation_ids_identity against checkpoint 001 and raises CausalForestRunnerError on any mismatch -- a resume can never silently continue under different parameters (tests/test_causal_forest_runner.py::test_resume_rejects_parameter_mismatch_against_checkpoint_one).
checkpointing.active_run_sentinel: src.causal_forest_runner.write_active_sentinel() writes the active run_id atomically to a file OUTSIDE the governed run root (default <run_root_base>/.t11_<stage>_active_run_id.txt), so a restart can discover which run_id to resume without inspecting outputs/runs/ contents. The sentinel is not part of immutable run evidence.
checkpointing.recovery_evidence: tests/test_causal_forest_runner.py::test_resume_after_crash_before_predictions_does_not_refit simulates a crash immediately after checkpoint 002 and proves a second run_stage() call resumes without invoking fit_causal_forest again and completes checkpoints 003/004.

unified_runner.cli: scripts/t11_run_stage.py (thin argparse wrapper only -- all orchestration logic stays in src/)
unified_runner.dag: verify identity (disjoint train/validation, StageRequest.__post_init__) -> load TRAIN partition only (stratified-subset draw for robustness/gcp_parity, or the complete frozen TRAIN population for full) -> fit -> atomic serialize+hash -> checkpoint 002 -> bounded reload check (RELOAD_CHECK_SAMPLE_SIZE=512) -> free TRAIN intermediates -> load VALIDATION partition only -> predict complete validation -> atomic persist+hash -> checkpoint 003 -> bounded diagnostic sample (diagnostic_sample_size) via aggregate_jacobian_support -> resource evidence capture -> checkpoint 004 -> finalize_artifact_manifest.
unified_runner.notebook_boundary: The runner never computes T06 frozen metrics or selects a seed -- that statistical narrative stays in the notebook (CLAUDE.md 'Notebook-first, not notebook-only'), which consumes the governed predictions.parquet artifact this runner produces.

stratified_subset_draw.mechanism: For population_size < len(train_ids) (robustness/gcp_parity), loads only a bounded 3-column [_source_row_id, treatment, conversion] projection for the candidate TRAIN ids (never the 12-feature set) to build the joint-(T,Y) stratification key -- same convention as src.split._joint_strata -- then sklearn.train_test_split(..., stratify=key, random_state=sampling_seed) draws exactly population_size ids. For population_size == len(train_ids) (full), the draw is skipped entirely and no projection is materialized (tests/test_causal_forest_runner.py::test_stratified_subset_skips_materialization_when_full_population).

numeric_commitments_D31.diagnostic_cohort_size: 100,000 -- APPROVED, used as diagnostic_sample_size for the bounded post-fit validation audit sample in every stage.
numeric_commitments_D31.robustness_population: 500,000 TRAIN rows -- UNCHANGED from D31, joint-(T,Y)-stratified, sampling seed 42, identical cohort across all three model seeds.
numeric_commitments_D31.full_disk_requirement: NOT frozen at this config version. Deferred to real measurements captured by src.causal_forest_runner._write_resource_evidence (audit/resource_evidence.json: model/predictions artifact sizes, run-root disk usage, peak RSS) during the 500K robustness runs. Target GCP provisioning may assume ~100GB disk pending that evidence; this is a provisioning assumption, not a frozen preflight gate.

smoke.purpose: Validate the T11 execution/recovery/data-loading path itself (partition loader, atomic serialization, checkpoint/resume, artifact manifest) on the SAME unified runner used by every other stage. Does not reopen T10 methodology and does not select on performance -- this is an infrastructure exercise, not a second correctness gate.
smoke.validation_scoring_note: Bounded VALIDATION subset (also drawn via stratified_subset_ids, same sampling_seed), NOT the complete 2,096,938-row frozen VALIDATION population -- sufficient to exercise the production predict/persist path without the cost of scoring the full cohort.
smoke.diagnostic_sample_size_note: Capped below the D31 100,000-row diagnostic rule because only 50,000 validation rows are in scope for SMOKE -- never invent a larger audit cohort than what was actually scored.
smoke.config: identical frozen config, unchanged from every other stage

full.population_note: Equals the complete frozen T05 TRAIN population -- no subsampling, no stratified draw.

robustness.rule: report all three seeds; never select a favorable seed; identical 500K cohort across all three (sampling_seed fixed at 42)

gcp_parity.population_size: <=50000 (exact value fixed in the parity config)

files.audit/run_config.json: written once, before fit, immutable thereafter
files.audit/checkpoints/001_started.json: run identity, frozen config + hash, train/validation ids identity (count+sha256, never raw ids)
files.audit/checkpoints/002_model_serialized.j: model artifact path/sha256, config_hash, actual_train_rows, bounded reload_verification
files.audit/diagnostic_support_summary.json: aggregate_jacobian_support() result on the bounded validation diagnostic sample
files.audit/resource_evidence.json: model/predictions artifact sizes, run-root disk usage, peak RSS at finalize
files.audit/artifact_manifest.json: written last, by finalize_artifact_manifest -- COMPLETED_PASS or COMPLETED_FAIL, hashes every prior artifact
files.predictions/validation_tau.parquet: [_source_row_id, tau] for the complete VALIDATION population, written via write_bytes_new_atomic

gcp_environment_contract.local_model_not_required_for_parity: GCP execution reproduces predictions independently from the frozen config/reference data; the local serialized model itself is never required or copied for parity.

failure_taxonomy.valid_algorithmic_seed_instability: Report only, no redesign -- matches T09's own precedent of reporting X-Learner's real cross-seed instability plainly.
failure_taxonomy.genuine_implementation_defect: Blocks FULL. Non-finite alpha/jac/tau, degenerate tau, config_hash drift, row misalignment, held-out access, reload divergence, unresolved exception, resume-identity mismatch.
failure_taxonomy.infrastructure_or_resource_failure: Operational diagnosis only, not automatically a model defect. OOM, disk-full, process kill, crash captured by the checkpoint/resume mechanism above.

lifecycle_state_evidence.note: Infrastructure-only IMPLEMENT phase. Real-data SMOKE/robustness/gcp_parity/FULL execution is a separate, not-yet-authorized action.
